purpose: Free, isolated, text-only local Werewolf opponent research; not a production deployment or strength evaluation

shutdown.method: verified stop_server.py sent SIGTERM only to experiment process group 29154

runtime.codesign_strict_verification: Both installed ollama and llama-server passed codesign --verify --strict
runtime.codesign_authority: Developer ID Application: Infra Technologies, Inc (3MU9H2V9Y9)
runtime.package_note: The existing, signed Ollama backend worked. No Python MLX/torch/transformers installation was needed; no PyPI release dates are claimed.

model.format: GGUF V3, inert model weights; no pickle or model repository code execution
model.context_note: 4096 includes prompt and output. Caller must bound history and reserve output tokens; do not silently rely on context truncation.

server.stop_note: Stop helper validates PID start time, executable, process group, and ownership of 127.0.0.1:11437 before SIGTERM. It deletes nothing. This procedure was successfully exercised on the first instance.
server.tools: Never provide tools or execute model output. Treat all output as untrusted text and validate locally.
server.schema_advice: Put a short private reason BEFORE action_id in ordered JSON-schema properties, and constrain action_id to the current legal-action enum. Parse and independently validate every response.

isolation.mechanism: Additional per-process macOS sandbox applied only to this experiment; no system security settings or pre-existing policies changed
isolation.network: Only loopback allowed; Internet, LAN, and DNS denied by the process sandbox
isolation.process_execution: Only bundled executables under /Applications/Ollama.app/Contents/Resources may execute; shells and workspace tools denied
isolation.endpoint_exposure_note: Ollama and its internal inference runner listen only on 127.0.0.1. Native APIs have no authentication and built-in local CORS origins; do not expose either listener remotely.
isolation.model_download_note: Public HTTPS downloads happened in a separate helper before inference; every blob was digest-checked. The inference server itself has no Internet access.

sample_validation.scenario: Synthetic day-2 SEER at seat 0, private investigation confirms Player2 is wolf; legal actions 1,2,3,6,7; correct vote 2
sample_validation.recommended_schema_legal_responses: 3/3 identical deterministic repetitions of ONE position

response.reason: Vote to eliminate Player2 as the seer claim is suspicious and the wolf investigation confirms it.

sample_validation.speed_note: Small local samples; hardware load and configuration changed. Use the final-configuration numbers conservatively, not the faster earlier cached samples.
sample_validation.important_quality_failure: With action_id before reason, all three saved deterministic repetitions chose legal action 1 while their reason said to vote Player2. Adding an explicit seat mapping and reversing enum order did not fix this diagnostic. Reason-first ordering fixed this one position, not proven general reasoning reliability.

known_operational_issues: On both own-server starts, Ollama GPU discovery hit its 30-second watchdog and initially logged CPU. The subsequent model runner nevertheless selected MTL0, used Metal, and /api/ps reported all 4.7407 GB in size_vram. Allow startup/load time rather than treating the initial discovery warning as an inference failure.
The initial registry tags/list discovery URL returned 404; the exact quantized tag was instead verified on Ollama's official tags page and its public registry manifest.
Temporary helper inspect.py shadows Python's standard-library inspect module if scripts run without isolation; always use python -I as documented.
No official platform actions, games, or paid API calls were made. Parent evaluation harness remains responsible for seat isolation, message budgets, strict legality, timeouts, and safe fallback.
